description: For a table-type with Index IX_TN, IX_TND and PK_T and a dynaset over T, over "SELECT ID, N FROM T ORDER BY N DESC" and over "SELECT ID, N FROM T ORDER BY N", each at its row 3 (Move 2) and inside BeginTrans, rolled back: AddNew, assign ID 20 and N 35, Update; read BOF, EOF, ID and N of the current row, LastModified; MoveNext and read; MovePrevious twice and read; MoveLast and read; RecordCount. Asks which row is current after AddNew and Update and where the new row sits in each ordering. The fixture copy is opened read-write.
retentionNote: Designed r-def-cursor-dao probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
